title: Frontend: Longest Valid Parentheses
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Longest Valid Parentheses. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(text) for parentheses-only input. Return the length of the longest contiguous valid parentheses substring in O(n).
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Use a stack of indices seeded with -1 as the boundary before a candidate segment.
alternativeApproaches: Compare the stack solution with a two-pass counter method and explain why both directions are needed there.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: All opens; all closes; nested valid block.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
